owner_decision: Preserve old 2513 tasks and submitted answers, audit old/new overlaps and conflicts, pre-screen historical candidates before requesting selective review. Current 1043 HL2 queue stays first.
rules: All historical tasks and every raw answer are retained; statuses come only from non-cancelled submitted annotations.
No target with unchanged inherited proposal is an explicit no-target answer; no target with modified geometry remains a conflict.
Core identity, core overlap, visible-window dependence and image similarity are distinct; cross-venue symbol/time collisions never justify label transfer or deduplication.
Exact duplicate review canvases do not erase original box or answer identities.
Known background overlaps are review holds for the next dataset; do not mutate historical negatives or infer a positive label.
Unanswered historical records await shape screening; neither an old star nor a geometric audit passes current semantic or training gates.
validation: Frozen source SHA and snapshot reconstruction
All 2513 identities have exactly one disposition
Interval adjacency and cross-venue negative controls
No service mutations, media/OHLCV reads or training
